plan_name: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, SBI General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; Modern treatments: up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Except for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24mo: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, ENT, calculi, varicose veins etc.; 36mo: joint replacement, age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate on claim; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

post_hosp.note: From date of discharge, for same condition

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; time limit of 24 hrs does not apply

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections etc. covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables listed in Annexure-A List I as non-payable items

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section 7.19 and 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; fresh 60mo for enhanced SI

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: For new individual policies with tenure of 1 year or more

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; credits for PED, specific waiting periods transferable

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary, OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, obesity surgery (conditional), gender change
